note: Hardin County Conservation park on 71 acres along the Iowa River, ~1/2 mi west of Alden, with 2 cabins and a shelter; no dump or showers. Open mid-April to mid-October, weather permitting. Carry-down river access for fishing/kayaking. Sites 2-4 sit along the river behind a fringe of bank trees; 10 and 11, near the cabins, look out on it. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 30/50-amp sites (now from the per-site pages, plus the $4 online fee), 12 sites (10 sold online, #5 host), vault restroom; added 14-night limit and booking note. Hardin County's own page still 403s. Riverview stands; the operator's 'along the Iowa River' on sites 2-4 is an upgrade lead. Note trimmed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade, riverview -> riverfront?): My County Parks says sites 2, 3 and 4 are 'situated along the Iowa River' and 10 and 11 have 'a beautiful view of the Iowa River'. On NAIP the river is ~45-50 m wide at the sites, and the north spurs end ~15-20 m from the water, but a fringe of bank trees stands between them and the water; I couldn't see an open apron at any pad. Stored riverview kept. The stored note's 'behind a continuous treeline' overstates it, so that wording was replaced.

BOOKING (no change, manual): the park page says 'Camping Sites are first come, first serve.', yet ten campsites are sold online with reservation and cancellation terms. The stored reservable/operator (AWH-read 2026-10-16) agrees with the per-site pages; the conflict is quoted in booking.note.
